objective: Materializar exclusivamente la migracion versionada de configuraciones EMAIL/WhatsApp de Catalogo Ampliado Gate 8G usando el canal canonico SQL_MIGRATION_DEVELOPMENT y el writer SQL canonico existente con opt-in explicito. Fallar cerrado si HRLectura no conserva permiso INSERT. No tocar Gate 8F, workflow dedicado, secretos, permisos SQL, canary ni Produccion.

queries.name: gate8g_identity_table_and_writer_insert_permission
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS user_name,CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','U') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS config_table_present,COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','OBJECT','INSERT'),0) AS can_insert,1/CASE WHEN DB_NAME()='EDARSAHUB' AND SUSER_SNAME()='HRLectura' AND USER_NAME()='HRLectura' AND OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','U') IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','OBJECT','INSERT'),0)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS gate8g_preflight_assertion

queries.name: gate8g_baseline_counts
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_provider_config' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo-ampliado%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS provider_count,SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_templates' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS template_count,SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_config' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%documento_vencimiento%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS config_count FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1

queries.name: gate8g_materialization_2plus2plus2_exact
queries.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_provider_config' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"provider\":\"smtp\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"token_ref\":\"email_password\"%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS email_provider,SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_provider_config' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"provider\":\"twilio\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"token_ref\":\"twilio_auth_token\"%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS whatsapp_provider,SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_templates' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS email_template,SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_templates' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS whatsapp_template,SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_config' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"modulo\":\"catalogo_ampliado\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"evento\":\"documento_vencimiento\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"provider\":\"smtp\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"modo_envio\":\"real\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"template_codigo\":\"catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento\"%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS email_config,SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_config' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"modulo\":\"catalogo_ampliado\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"evento\":\"documento_vencimiento\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"provider\":\"twilio\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"modo_envio\":\"real\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"template_codigo\":\"catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento\"%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS whatsapp_config FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1) SELECT email_provider+whatsapp_provider AS provider_count,email_template+whatsapp_template AS template_count,email_config+whatsapp_config AS config_count,email_provider,whatsapp_provider,email_template,whatsapp_template,email_config,whatsapp_config,1/CASE WHEN email_provider>=1 AND whatsapp_provider>=1 AND email_template>=1 AND whatsapp_template>=1 AND email_config>=1 AND whatsapp_config>=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS gate8g_postcheck_assertion FROM c
